articles.summary: Entertainment technology company and studio Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), has today announced new deals with streaming services Dropout and Eternal Family . The two companies have licensed premium content from Cineverse's library. Spanning tens of thousands of titles, this library has a valuation of approximately $45 million and spans TV shows and feature films across genres with powerful fandoms, from horror to anime to documentaries to sports and to indie films. Comedy streaming service Dropout has licensed Hundreds of Beavers , which is now available via SVOD at watch.dropout.tv . The wildly successful indie hit follows the story of a drunken applejack salesman who must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers. LA Times , The Washington Post and AV Club all included it as one of the best films of 2024 and Letterboxd named it 2024's Highest Rated Comedy. Eternal Family , the "hidden-gem video store," has licensed 10 titles
articles.title: Cineverse Licenses Indie Hit 'Hundreds of Beavers' to Dropout SVOD Comedy Platform, Plus 10 Titles to Eternal Family

articles.summary: Former Apple global infrastructure leader, technology founder behind Cineverse's Matchpoint® platform, and AI infrastructure entrepreneur nominated to join the Board as Cineverse advances its next phase of technology and platform innovation. Corp. (Nasdaq: CNVS) ("Cineverse" or the "Company"), an entertainment technology company and studio, announced the nomination for election to its Board of Directors of Dr. Samrat Ganguly at Cineverse's upcoming annual meeting of stockholders on December 8, 2026. Dr. Ganguly spent more than a decade at Apple, most recently as head of the Company's global network infrastructure organization, where he was responsible for the architecture, engineering and operations of the network and security infrastructure behind iCloud, Apple TV, the App Store and the broader Apple services ecosystem.
